title: Define typed EnforcementGap contract with stable gap codes
description: WHY: the refactor thesis is directives as projections of enforcement, which requires enforcement to speak a stable typed vocabulary. Today the closest thing is CloseoutGateGap (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 176-183) with free-text reason strings, plus BorealError details with inconsistent shapes. WHAT: design and land the EnforcementGap type in @boreal/core - a stable machine code (for example gate.verification.unsatisfied, work.blocked.open-dependency, reservation.not-ready, close.no-passing-verification, summary.missing), subjectId and subjectType, optional targetId, and a typed data payload sized to what the eventual directive needs (blocker ids, gate ids, required evidence kinds, min counts, declared commands). Write the enumeration of codes as a checked-in constant the registry inversion (sprint 3) will key against. Include a JSON schema under schemas/ mirroring the type, and an ADR-style note in docs/decisions recording the naming scheme, since gap codes become a public contract once directives key off them. Do not wire emission yet; that is the next task.
acceptanceCriteria: EnforcementGap type and gap-code constant enumeration land in packages/core with unit tests
JSON schema for the gap shape exists under schemas and validates fixture gaps
Decision note in docs/decisions records the gap-code naming contract
closedReason: Implemented and verified in checkpoint ffa6c80a.
